body:
Raw and powerful, these deep-blue Azurite clusters are natural antennas for the 963Hz frequency—a tone known for activating the pineal gland, enhancing inner vision, and aligning your mind with higher wisdom. Azurite has long been regarded as a priestess’s stone for intuitive insight, and this batch carries a rare vibrancy only found in high-altitude Moroccan mines.

Each cluster supports mental clarity, decalcifies intuitive centers, and opens your field to spiritual downloads and creative breakthroughs. Place it near your 963Hz Frequency Generator or meditation space to elevate your perception and reconnect with your spiritual purpose.
